<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The article lead (model article-lead@1): the heading, the lead paragraph, the byline (the portrait, the
  author, the date) and the cover picture. Axes: media (top: the cover over the copy, wide, start: the cover
  before the copy from md up, end: after it).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type ArticleLeadProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  image?: string;
  imageAlt: string;
  author: string;
  avatar?: string;
  date: string;
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  media?: "top" | "start" | "end";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  image = "",
  imageAlt,
  author,
  avatar = "",
  date,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "start",
  media = "top",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ArticleLeadProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const frame = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "top" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-12"
  : "grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-12 md:grid-cols-2"
);
const pictureClass = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "start" ? "order-first"
  : (media as string) === "top" ? "order-first"
  : ""
);
const ratio = computed(() => ((media as string) === "top") ? "21/9" : "4/3");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="article-lead"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box :class="frame">
        <Stack gap="6" :align="column">
          <Title :as="level" size="4xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="lg" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
          <Group gap="4" align="center">
            <MediaFrame :alt="author" :src="avatar" ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
            <Stack gap="0" align="start">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {{ author }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', '')">
                {{ date }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        </Stack>
        <MediaFrame :alt="imageAlt" :src="image" :ratio="ratio" :class="pictureClass" />
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
